business_summary: Fujian Nanping Sun Cable Co., Ltd. engages in research and manufacturing of wires and cables in China. The company offers aluminum alloy conductor cross-linked polyethylene insulated power cables, mining rubber sheathed flexible cable, control cable, PVC insulated wire, Polyvinyl chloride insulated power cables, cross-linked polyethylene insulated power cables, overhead insulated cable, photovoltaic cable, irradiation cross-linked halogen-free low-smoke flame-retardant polyolefin insulated wire and cable series, metal-sheathed inorganic mineral insulated cables, 220KV cables, and marine cables. It also provides plastic power cables, special overhead conductors, steel-cored aluminum stranded wires, computer cables, B and R series plastic wires, automotive wires, radio frequency cables, general-purpose rubber-sheathed cables, mining cables, marine cables, locomotive cables, nuclear power plant cables, wind power cables, silicone rubber insulated cables, submarine power cables, submarine optoelectronic composite cables, submarine cables, and land based high-voltage cables. In addition, it is involved in manufacturing and sales of copper rods; providing accommodation and catering services; and wholesale of hardware products, as well as manufacture and sale of metal materials. The company's products are used in transmitting electrical energy; transmitting information; and manufacturing equipment for various motors, electrical appliances, and instruments. Fujian Nanping Sun Cable Co., Ltd. was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Nanping, China.
